name: Kinovi
tagline: One API for video, image, and audio models.
description: Kinovi runs published video, image, and audio models through a public REST API. You create a task with a public model id, then poll for status, output URLs, and credits used. Credits are one-time packages at the rates published on each model page and at https://kinovi.ai/pricing. Studio is optional and uses the same credit balance. API docs: https://kinovi.ai/docs. A remote MCP endpoint is documented at https://kinovi.ai/docs/mcp.
